AboutPage.heroSubtitle: I am a web developer from Bratislava, driven by a passion for modern technology and a sense for detail.
AboutPage.storyText1: Omnicode started with a simple vision: to create websites that not only look good but, more importantly, deliver results. I believe that a successful website is a combination of clear content, clean code and a well-thought-out structure.
AboutPage.storyText2: Today I help clients launch or grow their online businesses. Every project is a new challenge for me, which I approach with enthusiasm and determination.

ServicesPage.heroSubtitle: I specialize in modern, fast and secure web solutions built on proven technologies.
ServicesPage.websitesText1: I create websites that not only look good but are also functional and user-friendly. I use modern technologies like Next.js and React, which help deliver speed, security and scalability. Each website is designed from the ground up with your goals and your customers' needs in mind.
ServicesPage.websitesText2: My goal is to create a digital business card that represents you well and helps you grow.
ServicesPage.eshopsText1: For your online business, I will create a custom e-shop that is ready for success. With platforms like WooCommerce and Salesforce Commerce Cloud, I build robust and easily manageable online stores. I focus on a good user experience, a smooth purchasing process and optimization for mobile devices.
ServicesPage.eshopsText2: From product import to payment gateway integration – I take care of the technical side so you can focus on selling.
ServicesPage.projectsSubtitle: Browse my work and get inspired for your next project.
